title: Storage & Messaging Decision Cheat Sheet — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Messaging Selection Flow: Pub/Sub vs Cloud Tasks vs Pub/Sub Lite evaluated on fan-out, rate-limiting, dedup, and message ordering requirements.
routing_rationale: Choosing between Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks is simple: Pub/Sub for many-to-many broadcast streaming; Cloud Tasks for point-to-point rate-limited task execution.

nodes.label: Pattern: 1 Publisher, 5 Independent Services
nodes.detail: Order created event must be consumed independently by Billing, Inventory, and Shipping.

nodes.label: Pattern: Protect Legacy Backend (Max 20 req/s)
nodes.detail: Must throttle requests so legacy database is not overwhelmed.

nodes.label: Selected: Cloud Pub/Sub
nodes.detail: Each downstream microservice has independent subscription and ACK state.

nodes.label: Selected: Cloud Tasks
nodes.detail: Guarantees dispatch rate never exceeds 20 requests/sec with exponential retry backoff.

nodes.label: Architectural Synergy
nodes.detail: Combines broadcast fan-out with protective downstream rate-limiting.

edges.label: 2. Rate Limiting -> Route to Cloud Tasks

steps.title: Pattern Evaluation
steps.action: Directs broadcast requirements to Pub/Sub and rate-throttling to Cloud Tasks.
steps.why_traversal: Applies the exact messaging service designed for each architectural pattern.

steps.title: Integrated Delivery
steps.action: Combines both systems for end-to-end reliability and downstream database protection.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents downstream microservices from crashing under upstream surges.

scenarios.label: Pub/Sub Subscriber Floods Legacy Database
scenarios.root_cause: Used Pub/Sub without rate limiting to call legacy database; 50,000 concurrent push deliveries crashed DB.
scenarios.recovery: Introduce Cloud Tasks or Pull subscriber with concurrency throttling in front of fragile databases.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
